paras: Step up your Nissan GT-R R35 's front braking performance with DIXCEL FS-Series two-piece brake rotors, engineered in Japan and developed through decades of OEM supply and motorsport experience. The FS-Series represents DIXCEL's premium two-piece rotor line, combining a lightweight aluminium centre hat with a precision-cast iron friction ring for reduced unsprung mass, improved thermal management, and superior performance over single-piece OEM rotors under demanding street and circuit conditions.

This listing covers a matched left and right pair of DIXCEL FS two-piece 380x34mm vented front brake rotors (part number FS-38034B24R/25L) designed for the early Nissan GT-R R35 (CBA-R35) chassis, produced from December 2007 to November 2010. The two-piece floating-style construction allows the friction ring to expand and contract independently of the hub, reducing rotor warping and providing more consistent pedal feel under repeat heavy braking - critical for a car as fast and as heavy as the R35 GT-R.
